parameters.name: BizType
parameters.description: The business type. Maximum of 64 characters.

parameters.name: DeviceId
parameters.description: The unique ID generated by the China Real Identity Authentication server for the device of the integrating party. This ID is generated only after the device is successfully activated and can be obtained by calling the getLicenseExtraInfo function in the offline facial recognition SDK.

parameters.name: ExpiredEndDay
parameters.description: The end time of the query, which queries the authorizations that expire between ExpiredStartDay and ExpiredEndDay.

parameters.name: ExpiredStartDay
parameters.description: The start time of the query, which queries the authorizations that expire between ExpiredStartDay and ExpiredEndDay.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: UserDeviceId
parameters.description: Maximum of 64 characters. Custom-defined by the integrating party to identify a specific device.
